Ethan invests an amount of money into an account which pays simple interest at a rate of $7\%$ per annum. Over a period of 4 years, the total interest earned is \$37,100.

How much money did Ethan invest?

solutions.latex:
Using the simple interest formula $I = Prn$:
$$\begin{aligned} 37\,100 &= P \times 7\% \times 4 \\ P &= \dfrac{37\,100}{7\% \times 4} \\ &= \$132\,500 \end{aligned}$$
Hence the answer is option C.

parts.latex: Adam wants to earn \$9000 a year in interest. How much must he invest if the simple interest rate is 15% p.a.? Answer to the nearest dollar.

solutions.latex:
Use the simple interest formula $I = Prn$ with $I = 9000$, $r = 0.15$ and $n = 1$ year.
$$\begin{aligned} 9000 &= P\times 0.15\times 1 \\ P &= \dfrac{9000}{0.15} \\ &= \$60\,000 \end{aligned}$$
Option C is correct.

Cleo purchased a new set of furniture using a simple interest loan. The furniture cost \$2300 and the interest rate on the loan is $12\%$ p.a.

If she is to pay off the loan over $2$ years, what will her monthly instalments be?

solutions.latex:
Use the simple interest formula $I=Prn$ with $P=2300$, $r=0.12$ and $n=2$.
$$\begin{aligned} I &= 2300\times 0.12\times 2 \\ &= \$552 \end{aligned}$$
The total to be repaid is
$$2300+552=\$2852$$
There are $2\times 12=24$ monthly instalments.
$$\begin{aligned} \text{Instalment} &= \dfrac{2852}{24} \\ &\approx \$118.83 \end{aligned}$$
This is option A.
